# What The AI

An AI tools directory: people browse by category and use case, so category choice and tags drive most of the traffic.

Notes from the directory list: AI tools directory.

## Steps
1. Open https://whattheai.tech/. If it's not a form, look for "Submit", "Add tool", "Get listed" or "Launch" in the header, footer or pricing page.
2. Search the site for `product.name` first. If a listing exists, `launchkit mark what-the-ai live --listing-url <url>` and stop.
3. Sign in if asked (preference order in docs/03). Mark `needs_human` on CAPTCHA, phone check or payment wall.
4. Fill the fields using the field map below. Pick the copy variant whose length fits each field.
5. Choose the free option on any pricing step. Submit, wait for the confirmation, screenshot it to `.launchkit/evidence/what-the-ai.png`.
6. `launchkit mark what-the-ai submitted --note "<what the confirmation said>"`

## Field map (generic; the real form may differ)

| Field on the site | Limit / format | Fill with |
|---|---|---|
| Name | text | `product.name` |
| URL | URL | `product.url` |
| Tagline / one-liner | usually 60-80 chars | `product.tagline` (or `product.tagline_short` if under 50) |
| Short description | usually 140-300 chars | `product.description_short` or `product.description_medium` |
| Long description | free text | `product.description_long` |
| Category / tags | select / chips | closest match to `product.categories`, then `product.tags` |
| Pricing | select | `product.pricing_model` (+ `product.pricing_details` if there's a text box) |
| Logo / icon | image | `assets.logo_square` |
| Screenshots | images | `assets.screenshots` (best first) |
| Video | URL | `links.demo_video` |
| Your name / email | text | `founder.name` / `submission.email` |
| Socials | URLs | `links.twitter`, `links.linkedin`, `links.github` |

## Make the listing perform
- Choose the most specific category that fits (e.g. "Code assistant" beats "Productivity").
- Fill every tag and use-case field. They feed the site's search.
- Many AI directories offer a paid "featured" upgrade. Skip it at budget 0. The free listing is the goal.
